info.title: Loading configuration changes from a file

abstract.para: The crm configure load command allows you to load configuration changes from a local file or a network URL. This command is useful if you prefer to prepare your configuration changes in advance. The &crmshell; validates the changes and warns you if the new configuration is invalid.

topic.para: You can load the new configuration with one of the following methods:

listitem.para: replace: Replaces the current configuration with the new configuration. If any resources are running, this method still adds new items and updates existing items, but doesn't remove any existing items.
update: Imports the new configuration into the current configuration by adding new items or updating existing items. This method can't remove any existing items.

push: Imports the new configuration into the current configuration by adding new items or updating existing items, and also removes existing items that are not present in the new configuration. This method can remove existing items even when resources are running, but only if the removed item isn't a running resource. If you try to remove a running resource, the command exits with an error.

step.para: METHOD can be one of replace, update or push. FILE can be a path to a local file or a URL to a remote file.
The &crmshell; checks the new configuration. If your changes would break the cluster configuration, you'll see the following output:
